store.title: App Store
store.browse.lede: Install one and it lands on your Home Screen as a single file you own — yours to keep, pass on, and modify. Hand the GIF to any AI: it unpacks it, changes what's inside, and packs it back. You don't need to know how to code.
store.pay.note: Installing is free. Leave a tip, or pay to feature a listing.
store.foot.intro: Every app here is a real GIF file.
store.err.tooLarge: This browser tab can’t store a file this large. A private or incognito tab keeps everything in memory and caps what it will hold — and it would forget the install when it closes. Open gifos.app in a normal tab and install again. ({msg})
store.err.tooLargeSized: This browser tab can’t store a file this large ({size}). A private or incognito tab keeps everything in memory and caps what it will hold — and it would forget the install when it closes. Open gifos.app in a normal tab and install again. ({msg})
store.err.saveFailed: Couldn’t save it to this computer — {msg}
store.legacy.notice: Your Home Screen is running release {release}, which was built before the App Store existed — it can’t receive an install yet. Update from {path}, then come back.
store.tooOld.title: {name} needs GifOS build {need} or newer.
store.tooOld.body: Your Home Screen runs {owner}, so this app can’t run there yet — installing it would leave you an icon that opens onto nothing.
store.tooOld.move: Move to release {release} or later in {path}, then come back.
store.tooOld.edge: No release has it yet — it is only in the unreleased edge build. Pick {edge} in {path}, or wait for the next release.
store.reviews.title: Reviews
store.reviews.none: No reviews yet — be the first.
store.reviews.how: A review is a pull request: one small JSON file under your GitHub name, in the same repo the apps live in. The button prefills it — or ask your AI to do it for you ({link}).
store.card.offlineTitle: Declares no network access — runs entirely on this device
store.card.extraLaterTitle: Extra files download the first time you open them, not at install
store.detail.portLine: of {who}. Bugs in this port go to {gifos}, not {name}.
store.detail.download: {size} download{hasModel, select, yes { + {model} model} other {}}{extra, select, yes { · extra files later} other {}}
store.fact.author: Author
store.fact.atInstallValue: {size} more, fetched when you install — not inside the app file.
store.fact.onPickValue: {n, plural, one {# extra file} other {# extra files}}{hasSize, select, yes {, about {size} if you take every one} other {}}. None of them download at install. Each one arrives the first time you open it, then stays on this device.
store.install.updated: Updated ✓ — your saved data is untouched.
store.err.mismatch: That download doesn’t match the catalog. Nothing was installed.
store.err.notApp: That file isn’t a GifOS app.
store.err.differentApp: That file is a different app than the listing. Nothing was installed.
store.err.badSignature: This app is listed as signed by {id}, but the signature didn’t verify. Nothing was installed.
store.err.assetRetry: ⚠ {msg} — the app will retry when you open it.
store.err.catalog: The catalog didn’t load. Check your connection and reload.
